Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.fusion

Class PoseSource

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.fusion.PoseSource
Direct Known Subclasses:
LimelightPoseSource, QuestNavPoseSource
public abstract class PoseSource extends Object
A source of pose measurements: a camera, a VIO headset, anything that can say where the robot is.

Writing one takes only two methods: getMeasurement(), which reads the hardware, and isPoseValid(Pose2d), which decides whether the resulting pose makes sense. Everything else --- motion filters, ambiguity, timestamps, telemetry, enabling and disabling --- is already here.

The filters

PoseFusion applies them in this order, and the first one that fails discards the measurement:
  1. Enabled, from code or from the dashboard.
  2. Environment: angular velocity, acceleration and linear velocity below their thresholds. This is evaluated before reading the hardware, so a source discarded on environment does not even spend the time of the read.
  3. Timestamp strictly newer than that of the last accepted measurement.
  4. Valid pose, according to the subclass.
  5. Ambiguity, if the source reports it.
  6. Consensus with the other sources; ConsensusGate arbitrates it.
  7. Mahalanobis against what the estimator already believes.

Standard deviations

There are two routes. A fixed one with setStdDevs(double, double, double), and a dynamic one with setStdDevsStrategy(BiFunction), which receives the distance and the tag count and returns the matching confidence. The second is the normal choice for vision, and StdDevStrategies ships the ready-made strategies.

  • Method Details

    • getMeasurement

      public abstract Optional<PoseSample> getMeasurement()
      Reads the hardware and returns this cycle's measurement, if there is one.

      It is only called when the source is enabled and the environment is valid, so none of that needs to be checked again.

      Returns:
      the measurement, or empty if there is nothing new.

    • isPoseValid

      public abstract boolean isPoseValid(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d pose)
      Decides whether a pose makes sense. The usual check is that it falls inside the field, with PoseFusion.isInField(Pose2d, double).
      Parameters:
      pose - pose to validate.
      Returns:
      true if the pose is acceptable.

    • getAmbiguity

      public OptionalDouble getAmbiguity()
      Ambiguity of the last PnP solution, if the source reports it.

      Returning empty --- which is the default behaviour --- means "this source has no such concept", and the ambiguity filter is skipped. That is the right thing for a VIO.

      Returns:
      the ambiguity from 0 to 1, or empty.

    • setEnabled

      public void setEnabled(boolean value)
      Enables or disables the source from code.

      It coexists with the dashboard switch without either of them getting lost: both are authoritative, and whichever moved last wins. See syncEnabledWithDashboard().

      Parameters:
      value - true to enable it.

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()

      true if the source is enabled.

    • telemetryDetail

      protected String telemetryDetail()
      A free-form detail the subclass can publish alongside the status.

      It exists so RejectionReason.NO_MEASUREMENT is not a dead end: "the source reported nothing" could mean the camera sees no tags, the headset is disconnected, or the timestamp is unusable, and from the dashboard all three look the same.

      Returns:
      a short line, or the empty string if there is nothing to add.
